**Issue 37 · November 2026 · Published by the Lindenhof Neighbourhood Association**

---

# The orchard is ours — for the next 30 years

![The Lindenhof community orchard in October, after the last apple harvest of the season.](data:image/png;base64,){width=100%}

After two years of negotiation, the city council voted on 22 October to lease the old nursery plot on Kirschweg to the association for thirty years, at a symbolic rent of one franc per year. The plot, about 4,200 square metres, has been used as a community orchard since 2019 on a short-term permit that the city could cancel with three months' notice.

"For the first time we can plant trees that will outlive the lease," said Ruth Ammann, who coordinates the orchard group. The group plans to plant 24 new standard trees this winter, mostly old local apple and pear varieties, and to build a tool shed with a rainwater tank in spring.

The lease comes with obligations: the plot must stay open to the public from dawn to dusk, and the association must insure it and keep the paths safe. The board will present a budget at the general assembly in January.

## How you can help

- **Plant a tree.** Planting day is Saturday 29 November from 9:00; bring a spade if you have one. Soup at noon.
- **Sponsor a tree.** CHF 120 buys and plants one standard tree; sponsors can name it.
- **Join the orchard group.** We meet on the first Tuesday of each month at 19:00 in the community room.

> "For the first time we can plant trees that will outlive the lease."

# New crossing at Talackerstrasse

![](data:image/png;base64,){width=35%}

The pedestrian crossing that parents have requested since 2021 is finally under construction. The city's traffic department confirmed that the crossing at Talackerstrasse and Schulweg will have a central island and lowered kerbs and will be finished before the Christmas holidays. Until then, a crossing guard will be on duty from 7:30 to 8:15 and from 11:45 to 12:15 on school days.

The association collected 860 signatures for the crossing in 2023, and three of our members spoke at the council's traffic committee. ==Thank you to everyone who signed.==

# Meet your neighbours: the repair café

![Volunteers at the repair café's October session.](data:image/png;base64,){width=70%}

On the second Saturday of every month, the community room smells of solder and coffee. Since it started in March, the repair café has fixed 214 items: lamps, toasters, bicycles, a 1970s record player and one very loved teddy bear.

"Most things are not broken, they just need a new fuse or a cleaned contact," says Tobias Frei, a retired electrician who leads the electrical table. Visitors are expected to stay while their item is repaired and, where possible, to learn how to do it themselves next time.

The café is looking for volunteers who can sew or repair bicycles. No formal training is needed — just patience.

> [!NOTE]
> The repair café does not accept microwave ovens or anything that runs on petrol. Mobile phones are checked, but parts are not supplied.

# Results of the neighbourhood survey

![Share of respondents who rated each topic as "important" or "very important".](data:image/png;base64,){width=60%}

Thank you to the 412 households who answered our survey in September — about a quarter of all households in Lindenhof. The topics most often rated as important were:

1. traffic safety around the school (81 %),
2. more shade and trees in streets and squares (74 %),
3. affordable rooms for clubs and private events (58 %),
4. a weekly market (52 %).

The board will use the results to set its priorities for 2027. The full report is available at the community room and on our website.

# Briefly

- **Lost and found:** a child's blue scooter has been at the community room since the summer party. Collect it during opening hours.
- **Book exchange:** the shelf at the bus stop on Lindenplatz has been replaced after storm damage. Please keep it dry — no books on the roof.
- **New members:** we welcome 18 new member households since the last issue. Membership is CHF 30 per year per household; [sign up online](https://lindenhof.example/join).
- **Room booking:** the community room can now be booked online at [lindenhof.example/rooms](https://lindenhof.example/rooms). Members pay CHF 20 per evening.
